execution_policy.advance_rule: Only start a ready item whose dependencies are passed. After passing it, mark direct successors ready only when all their dependencies are passed.
execution_policy.stop_rule: Stop on any unexplained parity mismatch, destructive data incompatibility, security regression, or failed VALUE-001/VALUE-002 gate. Keep Go production and do not change thresholds after observing Rust results.

items.title: Port full sidecar and retrieval stack
items.note: Integrated ce97dcf1 passes full immutable fixture generation/application, eight Go/Rust differentials and 204 CLI/index/protocol tests on Darwin/arm64 and Linux/arm64. Shared CLI/MCP local HyDE expansion preserves Go prompt, cache, dimensions and failure behavior; success bodies are bounded to 4 MiB. Integrated 3d4d8a56 additionally preserves the inert Go rerank flag in real CLI/MCP processes; complete immutable generation/application and the same native eight differentials/204 tests pass. Remaining facades/formats/quantization and other native targets stay open. Integrated a427ce7b additionally connects offline Ask CLI to shared hybrid retrieval and SearchPlan: seven Go cases, nine native differentials and 205 CLI/index/protocol tests pass on Darwin/arm64 and Linux/arm64; other facades and platforms remain open. Integrated bacaaff8 additionally preserves inert Go backend/quantization config through real CLI/MCP cases; immutable generation/application, nine differentials and 205 tests pass on both native ARM64 hosts. Current HTTP Ask candidate `7ae8ae34` (same production tree as immutable-fixture commit `e210b837`, Q=`368c2365`) adds shared hybrid retrieval for unscoped nonempty-index Ask while preserving notebook-scoped sidecar behavior; two source-bound Go cases passed with fake-loopback requests. Darwin/arm64 evidence: 16 CLI and 233 HTTP differentials, 210 CLI/index/protocol tests, strict Clippy/fmt, and validated immutable fixture application. Linux and other required native targets remain unverified for this slice; RUST-008 stays open. The bounded index status CLI slice (#1225) has 85 fresh Go/Rust pairs and 344 hash-verified output streams at d9bd9ebf38b47c98e33191e650c98569196250e0 on Darwin/arm64. Its source-bound native gate is scripts/rust-port/index-status/verify.py; Linux/Windows and final integrated-head CI remain acceptance requirements, not inferred from cross-compilation. See the bounded index status section of contract-matrix.md. This slice does not close INDEX-002, INDEX-005 or parent #1136. Bare `symdesk index` now writes hybrid retrieval chunks per new/changed Markdown document with Go-exact provider requests, rows, binary signatures and failure lifecycle (#1136, `make index-retrieval-cli-differential`); RUST-008 stays open. `symdesk index retry` replays Go per-failed-document retries with the bulk index's parse-failure handling (#1136, `make index-retry-cli-differential`); RUST-008 stays open. Bulk `index` and `--prune` now preserve Go's contained/external/broken symlink handling for Markdown inside the vault, including that external targets are never read (#1136, `make index-symlink-cli-differential`, Unix); RUST-008 stays open. `symdesk index --re-embed` now repairs pending `.csv` documents with Go's `parseCSV` extraction (encoding/csv reader port: CRLF folding, blank-line skipping, quoted newlines/quotes, ragged rows, tab-joined rows, and the first read error silently ending the file), proven by 35 Go-generated ParseFileSections cases (all byte-compared, including the invalid-UTF-8 case), three rejected mutants and a tampered-expectation control (`make retrieval-csv-sections-differential`) plus a seventh real-process re-embed case through a loopback fake provider (`make retrieval-reembed-http-differential`); RUST-008 stays open (PDF/Office/ODF/RTF/EPUB/HTML re-embed extraction and non-Darwin targets are not proven). `symdesk index --re-embed` now routes pending documents by Go `filepath.Ext` semantics, so dot-prefixed names (`.csv`, `.txt`, `.md`) are repaired like Go; three Go-generated cases extend `make retrieval-reembed-http-differential` to ten, and the pre-change Rust CLI fails the `.csv` case (#1136). CSV invalid-UTF-8 bytes now match Go: the stored chunk keeps the exact bytes in the TEXT column while the embedding request carries U+FFFD, replayed by two further real Go re-embed cases (invalid bytes and a rune-aligned hard split, twelve in total) and a rejected-mutant control (INDEX-005); reading such chunks yields U+FFFD instead of an error. RUST-008 stays open. Local gate at 727e021a335cd0840b5f76528b7c6fa6e2b89c30 (docs-only successors are source-equivalent): every acceptance target passes on macOS arm64 and Linux arm64 (`rust-check rust-lint rust-test port-contract`, all 18 retrieval differentials via `retrieval-differential` incl. `retrieval-ask-offline-differential`, the nine `index-*` differentials, `index-crate-test` 134/134, `index-status-cli-differential` incl. `scripts/rust-port/index-status/verify.py`, `config-*` differentials, `config-paths-native` 75/75 on both hosts) and `benchmark-large` was run as a measurement on both (Apple M4 Pro darwin/arm64, two runs: BenchmarkLargeVaultIndexAndSearch 5.22 and 5.86 s/op, BenchmarkGraphLargeVaultWithEntities 0.97 and 1.27 s/op; linux/arm64 container: 4.69 s/op and 1.21 s/op; one iteration each, no threshold set). CFG-001 is PASS (local). INDEX-002 and INDEX-005 stay TODO: `symdesk sources add|list|remove|watch` has no Go process fixture and a real probe shows divergent output, error wording and storage (Go indexes external folders into the shared retrieval database, Rust into the vault sidecar); closing it is the next functional slice. RUST-008 therefore stays ready. A single clean macOS receipt for the complete target list plus benchmark-large exists at ca3da857 (`macos-ca3da857-213954.log`, exit 0; logs copied under /Volumes/1TB_NVMe_SN850X/Dev/evidence/symaira-desktop/r008/gate-logs). Closure: `symdesk sources add|list|remove|watch` now replays a 37-step real Go process fixture (`make sources-cli-differential`, testdata/port/cli/sources-process.json) and Rust indexes external folders into the shared retrieval database like Go's IndexDirectory/RemoveDirectory/WatchDirectory (text and --json output, error wording, exit statuses, registry file, chunk/extraction rows, bounded watch cycle). Local gate at 3cf2f9477dc9439b4225621146c910b0956ac888 (docs-only successors are source-equivalent): rust-check rust-lint rust-test port-contract retrieval-differential sources-cli-differential, the index-* differentials, index-crate-test, index-status-cli-differential and benchmark-large exit 0 on macOS arm64 (macos-3cf2f947-024931.log) and Linux arm64 (linux-3cf2f947-041009.log). All RUST-008 contract rows are PASS or PASS (local) (INDEX-002 and INDEX-005 promoted; CFG-001 PASS (local) from 727e021a, unaffected). Hosted CI not claimed; Windows and macOS Intel are out of scope. Declared limits: see the `symdesk sources` facade section of contract-matrix.md.

items.title: Port PDF archive draw and export
items.note: RUST-011a slice 5 (#1142, RENDER-002): vault note/view/transclusion export is ported as symdesk_render::export_vault (export_note, export_view, resolve_transclusions) and replays the Go-built testdata/port/render/export-vault.json (118 cases over real disposable vaults: 104 exports and 14 returned errors; nested/diamond embeds, embed error lines, traversal, symlink escape, directory, 64 MiB read limit, missing and dangling paths, Markdown/HTML/PDF-source shapes, view tables) through make render-export-vault-differential. The replay is Unix-only; Windows validates the stored oracle without re-executing it. Go's resolveTransclusions has no cycle bound (a self-embedding note never returns); the port errors when an embed still remains after 10000 expansions (exactly 10000 with none left succeeds) or when the body passes 64 MiB, a deliberate declared limit with no Go case. A note body that is not valid UTF-8 is decoded lossily (U+FFFD) where Go keeps raw bytes, also declared and pinned by a Rust test. RUST-011a: split/merge/rotate adapters exist and the stub-tool differential executes 157 Go/Rust pairs, and the Go-oracle hostile replay with real Poppler/qpdf (455 pairs: bomb/recursion/encrypted/malformed inputs, traversal, aliasing, bounds; make render-pdfops-hostile-differential) passes locally on macOS and Linux arm64 at d96e645d (RENDER-001 PASS (local)). RUST-011a slice 6 (RENDER-002): pdfcpu image import and the pdfcpu stamp structure are ported with Go-generated canonical-PDF and rendered-pixel differentials (make render-archive-pdf-differential: 100 import + 51 stamp cases, including CCITT Group 3/4 TIFFs through x/image/ccitt), and the press Typst render pipeline with its PDF/A and PDF/UA gates is ported with a Go-generated differential through Typst 0.15.1 (make render-press-differential: 91 frontmatter + 70 render cases); the Linux gate image now installs the same pinned Typst. Declared limits are listed in the RENDER-002 matrix row. RENDER-002 is PASS (local): the export/archive/press differentials and the Linux gate image (Typst 0.15.1 in /usr/bin, so the fixture-check PATH finds it) pass on macOS arm64 and Linux arm64 at b7bac50a (port-contract + render-differential, both hosts exit 0), with CCITT Group 3/4 TIFF import now pinned by 15 Go-generated cases. RUST-011 as a whole still depends on the RENDER-003 sibling (SymDraw GIF/animation/Typst/PDF output, fuzz target). RUST-011b slice 1 (#1143, RENDER-003): the SymDraw DSL parser (Mermaid flowchart/graph + sequenceDiagram subset, JSON IR with Go encoding/json error semantics, IR validation) is ported in symdesk_render::draw and replays the Go-generated dsl-parse.json (3316 cases, 811 accepted, 2505 rejected; custom values to Go's depth 10000 handled iteratively on a 1 MiB stack) byte-for-byte via make render-ir-differential. The parser has no dependency on the PDF ops/export slice (#1142). RUST-011b slice 2 (#1143, RENDER-003): the text measurement layer (internal/draw/measure over the embedded Inter fonts: MeasureText/Detailed, BreakLines, MeasureNode, NormalizeFontWeight, font hashes; minimal sfnt reader) is ported in symdesk_render::draw::{measure,sfnt} and replays the Go-generated text-measure.json (5847 cases incl. a digest sweep over every Unicode scalar value) byte-for-byte via make render-ir-differential. RUST-011b slice 3 (RENDER-003): internal/draw/theme and internal/draw/scene (theme registry, Rect algebra, primitive bounds and json.Marshal bytes, Scene ComputeBounds/FitToBounds/Validate, DefaultMarkers) are ported as symdesk_render::draw::{theme,scene} and replay the Go-generated scene-bounds.json (3422 cases; host-dependent FMA cases withheld by the generator) via make render-ir-differential. RUST-011b slice 4 (RENDER-003): internal/draw/layout (layered Sugiyama-style graph layout and the closed-form sequence layout, including Go's sort.SliceStable block/symMerge algorithm because the median comparator is not a strict weak ordering) is ported as symdesk_render::draw::layout and replays the Go-generated layout.json (640 cases: 521 layered + 119 sequence, 443+28 results and 78+91 exact error texts; 2 circle graphs and 1010 non-diagram mined strings withheld by the generator) via make render-ir-differential. RUST-011b PNG slice (RENDER-003): the PNG emitter (rasterizer port of x/image/vector + byte-exact Go image/png and compress/flate level 6, arm64 FMA arithmetic) replays the Go-generated png.json (1346 cases: 1273 PNG SHA-256, 49 builder errors, 24 oversized scenes withheld) via make render-png-differential. GIF/animation/Typst and the draw facade followed in RUST-011b (RENDER-003 PASS (local)). RUST-011 closure: `cargo +nightly-2026-09-03 fuzz run draw_parser` now exercises parser, IR serialization, layout, SVG/Typst/PNG facade output and GIF animation; 1800-second runs on macOS arm64 (144,635 runs) and the Linux arm64 container (102,484 runs) finished with no crash, OOM or timeout after two layout hot spots found by earlier runs were fixed (transposition crossing recount, median ordering); an unbounded `A & B --> C & D` fan-out layout cost (26k edges, 35 s) is a declared Go-parity limit, see RENDER-003. SEC-001 scope for this item is the render/PDF subset (PASS (local)); the ZIP/archive-bomb subset belongs to RUST-010 (Go reads archives only in ingest extract and retrieval parser), so the SEC-001 matrix row stays TODO. Status stays ready until the final two-host gate (rust-lint rust-test port-contract render-ir-differential render-differential) and `cargo nextest run -p symdesk-render` pass on the closing commit. RUST-011 passed (local) at bdf95516: two-host local gate rust-check rust-lint rust-test port-contract render-ir-differential render-differential retrieval-differential sources-cli-differential exit 0 on macOS arm64 (macos-bdf95516-091421.log) and Linux arm64 (linux-bdf95516-113201.log); draw_parser fuzz 1800 s per host without crashes; SEC-001 obligation of RUST-011 is the render/PDF subset (PASS (local)), the ZIP subset moves to RUST-010. Mermaid `&` cross-product fan-out keeps Go's unbounded behaviour by owner decision (declared limit in RENDER-003).
